capabilities: Open any Markdown file as an editable mind map
Edit map nodes and write changes back to headings and lists
Toggle and track tasks from map nodes
Link a map to a note tab and reopen it automatically
Bookmark nodes and restore saved map views
disambiguation: Not a standalone mind-mapping file format; it edits existing Markdown headings and lists and stores nothing new.
extras: Development documentation is kept separately in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.
problem: Outlines in Obsidian can only be edited as plain text; there is no visual way to restructure a note's headings and lists as a tree.
summary: Mind map editor that renders a note's headings and lists as an editable mind map and writes edits back to the same Markdown file.
